in_sanskrit.name: वेणु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वेगस्विन्यस्य वेणुं नमस्कर (welcome O God of music and knowledge)

in_marathi.name: Venu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Venu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Venu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vayu', which means wind. It is also the name of the god of music and dance in Hindu mythology. Therefore, this name signifies both the natural element of wind and the creative and peaceful aspects of music.
